ev.q: COPD prevalences were 6.0% (3.4 million) among those who ever smoked and 2.2% (2.4 million) among those who never smoked.
Highest prevalences were among workers aged ≥65 years (4.6%), women (3.0%), and those reporting fair/poor health (6.7%).

an estimated 2.4 million (2.2%) U.S. working adults aged ≥18 years who never smoked had COPD.
Women had higher COPD prevalences than did men.

methods_quotes.q: Prevalence estimates with relative standard error (standard error of the estimate divided by the estimate) ≥30% were not reported.
